description: Capability and evidence inventory, NOT implementation progress. PROVEN is fixture-scoped. 28 base maps plus one annex are not completed by listing them.

status_legend.PROVEN: Native fixture or CI tested within stated scope
status_legend.HUMAN_ONLY: Human editor/module has it but native map agent cannot invoke it
status_legend.PARTIAL: Source exists, unified agent/runtime parity incomplete
status_legend.GAP: Agent construction path cannot yet perform it
